name: Eira
role: Captured Shadow Fleet command operator bearing the functional title Valkyrie
custody_status: Medical isolation and emergency evidence-preservation hold followed by Field Court judicial sealing and preservation order.
stable_identity_anchors: Understands command as responsibility for returning people who cannot return themselves.
Served as a central but not necessarily singular operator within Crown Dark's distributed command architecture.
Attempted to prevent capture of Crown Dark and its command network through catastrophic collapse.
Was captured alive by Talon Detachment.
States that she has no family name; no fleet-wide naming rule is inferred from this statement.
testimony_claims_staging: The Union boarded the wrong vessel by attacking Crown Dark rather than the concealed containment vessel.
Actors inside the Union opened the dark star during an earlier incident.
The Judicator Prime Field Court was under attack from the moment the Union entered the system through erased records, divided evidence, and delayed institutional response.
Valkyrie is a command function associated with deciding which linked minds can return from the fleet.
The system-wide sensor flare was a recognition event in which the star reconstructed or exposed an external pattern.
The flare reached anything built to remember the pattern.
The Shadow Fleet entered Lethan to return what had been removed and recover any mind carrying an open pattern.
Observation, memory, computational recording, or proximity may create a route for exposure.
The Shadow Fleet does not name dark-star phenomena because names may create stable paths.
Related structures may already exist within inhabited systems or recorded data environments.
corroborating_observations: The sensor flare exposed previously concealed Shadow Fleet vessels and additional anomalous returns.
Seventeen outbound vectors were recovered from the flare and synchronized captive response.
Some recovered Crown Dark operators displayed knowledge, languages, or perceptions not readily explained by their confirmed movement aboard Judicator Prime.
Crown Dark command-network records contained degraded forms of the same vector pattern.
epistemic_boundary: Eira's statements are testimony and intelligence leads, not independently proven history or mechanism unless corroborated by later evidence. Correlating observations strengthen investigative priority without proving her interpretation.
promotion_pass: Dark Star Narrative Reconciliation Pass — 2026-07-22; Third Silence Narrative Audit — 2026-07-22
status_detail: Alive, held in Union custody following recovery from Crown Dark.
